source.text: The Solar System is the gravitationally bound system of the Sun and the objects that orbit it. It formed 4.6 billion years ago from the gravitational collapse of a giant interstellar molecular cloud. The four inner planets are rocky, while the outer planets are gas and ice giants.

media.alt: A star-filled view of space representing the solar system.

segments.heading: What is the Solar System?
segments.sourceText: The Solar System includes the Sun and all objects that orbit it.

segments.heading: The Inner Planets
segments.sourceText: Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars are rocky inner planets with solid surfaces.

segments.heading: The Outer Planets
segments.sourceText: Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants. Uranus and Neptune are ice giants.

source.text: A fraction shows a part of a whole. The numerator tells how many parts are selected. The denominator tells how many equal parts the whole is divided into. Equivalent fractions represent the same value even when the numerator and denominator are different.

media.alt: A circle divided into four equal parts with one part shaded.

segments.heading: Meaning of a Fraction
segments.sourceText: A fraction shows a part of a whole.

segments.heading: Numerator and Denominator
segments.sourceText: The numerator is the top number. The denominator is the bottom number.

segments.heading: Equivalent Fractions
segments.sourceText: Equivalent fractions look different but have the same value.
